newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKS EXTEND CAR IMPORT SCHEME APPLICATION PERIOD.
newsitem.headline: TURKS EXTEND CAR IMPORT SCHEME APPLICATION PERIOD.

text.p: The application period for a Turkish government duty free car importation scheme has been extended, State Minister Sabri Tekir said on Monday.
"The application period has been extended by 15 days from January 1," Tekir told Reuters.

The scheme, in effect since October, allows for Turkish citizens to import one used foreign car, up to four years old, for each sum of 50,000 marks they deposit in the state Ziraat Bank. The accounts will earn 10 percent annual interest.
The number of such accounts opened had reached around 24,000 and the application period was extended because of the high level of demand from expatriate Turks, Tekir said.
The government expects a total of 25,000 application under the scheme.
